Class AutoPaymentsCreateBillsTest

@IsTest()
private class AutoPaymentsCreateBillsTest

Test class for AutoPaymentsCreateBills that validates bill creation for accounts with automatic payments enabled. Tests both the direct runFlow() invocation and the Schedulable interface execution.
